pack.subtitle: Buy 2, get the 3rd free · Mon 2 Nov 2026 to Fri 12 Feb 2027 · 9:16 videos with licensed music, 4:5 and 9:16 stills
intro: 150 videos (W01 to W150) and, for W51 to W150, a matching 4:5 feed still and 9:16 story still (S51 to S150). They are grouped by when to run them: November, Christmas run-up, Christmas holidays, New Year and back to school, late January and February. Each period has its own zip and this pack covers that period only.
Offer on every end card: Buy 2, get the 3rd free. 3 for £36, 6 for £72, 9 for £108. Ends Fri 12 Feb 2027.

Terms on every end card and in every primary text: £18 tickets. New customers only. Sign up at explorazone.co.uk or ask at reception, and follow us on Instagram and Facebook. Max 9 per group. T&Cs apply.
Every primary text also says: We reserve the right to end this offer sooner. If the offer is ever ended early, honour claims already made and announce the new end date in advance (CAP Code rule 8.2).
No Christmas or New Year opening dates appear anywhere. Check opening times before running holiday videos on days the centre is closed.
insights: Last 90 days: the B2G3 leads campaign from 24 August is still the cheapest source of sign-ups, so put these videos into lead campaigns first.
People in the lead campaigns are now seeing the same static ads more than three times each. Fresh video should bring results back up.
Awareness campaigns buy cheap reach but very few clicks. Use them only for the strongest 5 to 8 videos, after a week of lead data.

Parents 25 to 44 lead the set (103 videos). 47 videos speak to grandparents and three generations, including 31 of the 100 new ones, for the grandparents ad set; they drove most attributed purchases in the static-ad data.
The half-term videos (EXZ_HT26) start on Fri 23 Oct. Their results will shape any changes to the January and February periods.

Director feedback (20 Oct): Norwich winters are grey, cloudy and dark rather than frozen or snowy, the city centre is busy and crowded from November to January, and Explorazone is outside the ring road. The videos and primary texts use these hooks; 14 primary texts add "Skip the city-centre traffic and crowds: we are outside the ring road, in Bowthorpe."
launch: Upload each video as its own ad, using the ad name from the sheet exactly (for example EXZ_WIN27_W97_operation-sleepover), so results trace back to the creative. For W51 to W150, add the two stills to the same ad or run them as their own ads named from the stills sheet (for example EXZ_WIN27_S97_operation-sleepover).
Use one ad set per folder (Families or Grandparents), with broad targeting and Advantage+ placements (Reels, Stories and Feed on). Switch each period on and off on its dates.

Dates: November, 2 to 29 Nov. Christmas run-up, 30 Nov to 20 Dec. Christmas holidays, 19 Dec to 4 Jan (W35, W38, W39, W95, W96, W98, W99, W100, W101 and W104 from 26 Dec). New Year and back to school, 1 to 10 Jan. Late January, 11 to 31 Jan. February, last chance, 1 to 12 Feb.
Leave each group 5 to 7 days before judging. Pause clear losers (weak hook rate and no results) and keep the winners running.
The lead form and landing page must show the same offer and terms as the videos.
After a week, send the results or ask Claude for "smvm feedback" so the next batch learns from them.
